slides.teacher_cue: Four l-final clusters. -ld (bold, hold, cold, gold), -lp (help, yelp, gulp), -lk (milk, silk, bulk), -lm (film, elm, calm). The l comes first, then the second consonant. Both must be produced. The -old family is a key high-frequency pattern: bold, cold, fold, gold, hold, old, sold, told.
slides.expected_response: Students produce all four l-final clusters and learn the -old family as a unit.
slides.correction_move: Model each cluster. Then teach the -old family as a word family — same chunk, different onset. Students generate as many -old words as they can.
slides.observation_note: Watch for /r/ substitution for /l/ — still active. And watch for final cluster reduction.

slides.teacher_cue: Say the new focus, then connect clusters to one strong word from today.
slides.expected_response: Students say clusters clearly and connect it to a lesson word.
slides.correction_move: Model the focus once, then have students echo and use it in a known word.
slides.observation_note: Listen for whether students can carry the focus from isolation into a real word.

slides.teacher_cue: Say gold — the precious metal. -ld final cluster. Long /oʊ/ before the cluster. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say gold orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model gold orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for long /oʊ/ in old and -ld cluster — both l and d clear.

slides.teacher_cue: Mime holding something. Say hold — -ld cluster. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say hold orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model hold orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for -ld at the end — both sounds present.

slides.teacher_cue: Say help — to assist. -lp final cluster. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say help orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model help orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for -lp at the end — both l and p clear.

slides.teacher_cue: Say milk — the white drink. -lk final cluster. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say milk orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model milk orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for -lk at the end — both l and k clear.

slides.teacher_cue: Say film — a movie; also a thin layer. Confirm /f/ onset and -lm final cluster. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say film orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model film orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for /p/ on /f/ and -lm at the end.

slides.teacher_cue: Say bold — brave and confident. -ld cluster. Same -old family as gold and hold. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say bold orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model bold orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for -ld cluster and long /oʊ/.
